caption: The drawing features a large central depiction of an ornate pitcher with a broad, rounded body, three curved legs ending in decorative feet, a complexly shaped spout with a ruffled edge, and an elaborately curled handle. The pitcher appears to be rendered in shades of gray and black pencil, with careful shading to indicate its three-dimensional form and metallic texture. Above and to the right of the main pitcher is a small, simplified line drawing of the same pitcher, showing its outline and major features. In the lower left quadrant, there is a vertical drawing of a cylindrical object that resembles a stylized rod or straw, also rendered in gray pencil. The background of the image is a plain, light tan or cream color showing some signs of aging or discoloration. In the lower right corner, the name "Amelia Tuccio - 1936" is handwritten.
title: Silver Creamer
